objects.text: Results-driven Marketing Manager with 6+ years experience steering strategic campaigns and brand development in tech and consumer sectors. Skilled in market analysis, digital marketing execution, and budget management, driving significant growth in leads and conversions. Adept at collaborating with sales, product, and creative teams to deliver aligned marketing strategies.
• Led a cross-channel marketing campaign that increased qualified leads by 38% within the first 9 months, supporting a revenue growth of $4.2M.
• Developed and managed a $1.5M annual marketing budget, optimizing spend across digital, events, and partnerships to boost ROI by 27%.
• Directed the launch of two new SaaS products, collaborating with product and sales teams to achieve a 22% month-over-month user adoption rate in first 6 months.
• Implemented data-driven SEO and PPC strategies that elevated organic traffic by 52%, improving conversion rates by 14%.
Associate Marketing Manager — VeroLux Consumer Goods
• Orchestrated integrated marketing campaigns for new product lines, achieving a 30% increase in market share within 12 months.
• Spearheaded social media strategy, growing followers by 120K and engagement by 65%, aligning with brand repositioning efforts.
• Collaborated with R&D and branding teams to refresh company website, resulting in a 40% decrease in bounce rate and a 19% increase in time-on-site.
• Monitored campaign analytics and prepared monthly performance reports with insights that guided strategic pivots.
Bachelor of Business Administration, Marketing Concentration – Stratford University, 2017

Strategic Marketing Planning  ·  Budget & Resource Management  ·  Digital Campaign Management  ·  Lead Generation & Conversion Optimization  ·  SEO & SEM  ·  Cross-functional Team Leadership  ·  Data Analytics & ROI Measurement  ·  Product Launch Strategy
• Certified Digital Marketing Professional (CDMP) – Digital Marketing Institute, 2019
